newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Imasco with stable trends.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Imasco with stable trends.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday that it confirmed the ratings of Imasco Ltd, following the company's agreement to sell its Hardee's Food Systems Inc unit.

DBRS confirmed the rating of Imasco's debenures and medium term notes at A, its preferred shares at Pfd-2 and its commercial paper at R-1 (low). The ratings trend for Imasco is stable, the Toronto-based agency said.

On Monday, Imasco said it agreed to sell Hardee's to CKE Restaurants Inc for C$457 million. Imasco will also write off deferred tax status in the amount of C$66 million and will book a provision of aobut C$60 million for certain liabilities and costs.
Fast Food Merchanisers, the food processing and distribution business, is not included in the transaction.
